reviews.rationale: Complete Q2 FY2025 packet now supplies all three required metrics. Revenue rose to 30,040 USD million (+15.4% vs 26,040 baseline) and Data Center revenue to 26,300 USD million (+16.4% vs 22,600 baseline), supporting the revenue-growth catalyst and Data Center strength. However, GAAP gross margin declined to 75.1% from 78.4% (a 3.3 pp contraction), which pressures the margin-resilience catalyst and is directionally consistent with the material-margin-deterioration invalidation. Net effect is mixed: strong top-line and segment growth offset by margin compression. No single-quarter margin move yet constitutes sustained segment weakness, so the thesis is maintained with unchanged status and conviction while flagging margin as the key risk to monitor.
